headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a thrilling 2-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Simeon Woods Richardson earning the win and Louis Varland notching the save. Brett Baty led the New York Mets' offense with a home run and four RBIs in their 8-5 win over the Atlanta Braves. Josh Bell hit a home run and drove in three runs for the Baltimore Orioles in their 9-5 loss to the Minnesota Twins.

Several key players have been sidelined due to injuries. Daniel Susac has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left knee patella fracture, while Tyler Freeman is out with lumbar pain. Nathan Eovaldi has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right posterior elbow inflammation, and Shaun Anderson is out with right shoulder inflammation.

The Kansas City Royals have made a move, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics for RF Colby Thomas, while the Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 2-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Simeon Woods Richardson earning the win and Louis Varland notching the save.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Braves 8-5**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured an 8-5 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty leading the team's offense. Baty hit a home run and drove in four runs, while Brent Suter pitched three scoreless innings in relief.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies took down the St. Louis Cardinals 6-5, securing a hard-fought win. Edmundo Sosa led the Phillies' offense with 2 hits, 3 RBIs, and 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Giants' Daniel Susac Sidelined with Knee Injury**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants catcher Daniel Susac has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee patella fracture. The injury occurred on August 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster following the trade.
